description: Files the nine VAT boxes the user has confirmed (derive_vat_return's hmrc fields) over the deployed API, for vatNumber or, when clientId is given instead, for that practice client's own VRN. Boxes 3 and 5 are HMRC's own totals and are not sent; the route derives them. Uses the session's HMRC authorisation: call request_hmrc_authorisation first if this tool says none is held.

allowSyntheticObligations.description: Synthetic only: file under any open obligation if the dates do not match

clientId.description: A practice client's id, to resolve vatNumber from the client row instead

hmrcAccount.description: Which HMRC environment to call; defaults to the session's HMRC authorisation's own

vatNumber.description: VAT registration number, 9 digits; required unless clientId is given

name: submit_vat_return
title: Submit a VAT return
